description: A woman in a dark patterned high-waisted dress with a white lace collar and long black gloves sits in a wooden chair, turned to the right, with her dark hair up. An open book rests on her lap. A man in a dark jacket leans over a writing desk at right, reading a sheet of paper, with quill pens in an inkwell and stacks of paper beside him. Lit candles stand on a side table at left and on the desk, in a dim panelled room; a gilt-framed picture hangs at the top-left edge. The dress and furnishings look early nineteenth century, and the marks on the pages are scribbles, not legible letters.
